REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - DECEMBER 14, 2006 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
5A.
Consideration of Appointments to Vacancies on Various Commissions, Boards and Committees. Consideration of appointment to the Economic Development Commission
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
6A.
Report back from the November 9, 2006 City Council/Redevelopment Agency meeting regarding code enforcement procedures
Consent Calendar
7.
Registers of Demands dated 12/14/2006
8.
Approval of Treasurer’s Report for the period ending 10/31/2006
9.
Minutes of 11/20/2006
10.
Resolution for consideration and adoption. Reading of resolution waived and resolution adopted
10A.
Consideration of adoption of the Fiscal Year 2006-2007 appropriation limit. A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos approving and adopting the annual appropriation limit for Fiscal Year 2006-2007
11.
Miscellaneous
11A.
Consideration of the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency’s Annual Financial Report for Fiscal Year 2005-2006
11B.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 1047-07, purchase of two new LCD projectors
12.
Public Hearings
12A.
Development Code Amendment 2006-10 - An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Chapter 6.20, Property Maintenance, of the Cerritos Municipal Code defining the term "Screened" to mean located behind a legally permitted opaque wall, fence, gate or hedge of at least six (6) feet in height when pertaining to the storage of vehicles, including recreational vehicles, on property zoned residential
13.
Pending Legal Matters/Resolutions for consideration
13A.
A joint resolution of the Cerritos City Council, Cerritos Redevelopment Agency, and Cerritos Public Financing Authority adopting conflict of interest codes and repealing Resolutions No. 2004-44, CRA 2004-10, AND CPFA 2004-2
13B.
A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos providing for certain adjustments in the employment system and the personnel policies, for all part-time temporary employees, including temporary part-time employees represented by the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME) Local 619, and repealing Resolution No. 2004-28 and all related amendments
14.
Public Works Activities
14A.
Consideration and award of contract for the reconstruction f the C-1 Building/Chlorine Containment, 12701 Artesia Boulevard, (APN 7030-001-900) Bid No. 1036-07, Project No. 17003
15.
New and Old Business
15A.
Consideration of the Annual Report of the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency for Fiscal Year 2005-2006
15B.
Review and consideration of reservation fees and use policies for community centers, Cerritos Senior Center and park facilities
15C.
Consideration of the assignment of the Ground Lease for 17777 Center Court Drive in the Cerritos Towne Center from Bloomfield Cerritos Associates, LLC, a California Limited Liability Company, to Arden Realty, LP, a California Limited Partnership or its affiliate (APN 7030-011-012)
16.
Report on Pending Legislation
17.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
18.
Closed Session
18A.
Public employee performance evaluation pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 and labor negotiations with unrepresented employees pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6. Title: City Attorney. Agency Designated Representative: Anthony Canzoneri
18B.
Conference with labor negotiators pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6. Agency Designated Representatives: Councilman John F. Crawley and Councilwoman Gloria A. Kappe. Unrepresented Employees: City Attorney
18C.
Personnel matters pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6: Conference with labor negotiators. Agency Negotiators: Vince Brar, Denise Manoogian and Patricia Leyva. Employee Organization: Part-time Bargaining Unit, AFSCME, Local 619
18D.
Public employee performance evaluation pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 and labor negotiations with unrepresented employees pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6. Title: City Clerk. Agency Designated Representative: Josephine Triggs. Title: City Manager. Agency Designated Representative: Art Gallucci
18E.
Conference with labor negotiators pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6. Agency Designated Representatives: Councilman John F. Crawley and Councilwoman Gloria A. Kappe. Unrepresented Employees: City Clerk and City Manager
19.
Consideration of salary and compensation adjustments for City Charter Employees
20.
Adjournment
Recess
Reconvene
